summary.text: Lawrence Quintal is the Republican candidate for the Massachusetts House of Representatives 3rd Bristol District in the November 3, 2026 general election against incumbent Democrat Lisa Field.

paragraphs.text: Lawrence Quintal also ran for the 3rd Bristol District in a 2025 special election, advancing from the May 13, 2025 Republican primary.
Lisa Field defeated him in the special general election on June 10, 2025.
He advanced from the September 1, 2026 Republican primary for the regular election.
